<!-- pr-reviewer: e26e5a467ca7c5d7d80a3c89731e5c614f9011f3 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The token defaults keep the old colours. The alpha helper reads unmultiplied channels. The body has before/after screenshots. All 10 linked image pairs are available, are 1280 × 720, and have equal pixel data.

Requested before merge:

1. **[P3] Include the theme colours in both drawing caches.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library_dialog/thumbs.rs:100` now reads `thumb_flute` and `tool_shank` when it builds coloured shapes. But `shapes_of` at lines 60–73 returns the old shapes when only the tool value matches. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library_dialog/holder_view.rs:241` also stores theme colours in shapes. Its key at lines 176–183 and 206 contains only the name, rectangle, unit and dimension flag. Draw either view, then select a theme with different drawing colours. The cached shapes keep the previous colours. The holder ground and labels can change while its body, edge, axis and dimension lines keep the old colours. This breaks the frame-cost rule: the cache key must contain its inputs. Include the relevant colours in both keys, or apply live colours when cached geometry is painted. Add a regression test for each cache that draws once, changes those colours, and checks the next drawing. Keep the tests that show a still frame builds no new geometry. This is one finding class at two sites, found by code inspection. The new token tests do not exercise these cache returns.

Local results, trial-merged with upstream/main `5b52c5f8ca0a03e8b71af0453056b920b5d9e742`:

- Trial merge: clean. Its first parent is the PR head above. The change commit and the hand resolution in the merge commit were read. The full diff against current main was also read.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 10 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- Build with `--no-run`: passed.
- UI lib: 1,688 passed, 8 ignored, 0 failed.
- UI integration suites: boundary 3 passed; boundary_picks 7; contour_dxf_sketch 2; sinker_setup 2; tap_hand 3; theme_example 3; theme_files 33; waterjet_tool 1. No failures.
- `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings`: passed.

Extra suites run: none outside the quick gate. No fixture, importer, post, operation, motion or catalog file changes in this diff. No recorded program or golden file changes.

Mutations: not run. This change affects display colours only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge or collision checks. No heavy lane is needed for this UI change.

No code was changed for this review. The warm review worktree and branch remain in place. The draft state, labels and title are unchanged, as requested for this review. The review state would be `needs-rework` until the finding is fixed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Hi @sn3ro. One finding from the last review is still open here (head `e26e5a467`). `thumbs.rs` now draws with the `thumb_flute` and `tool_shank` theme colours, but the two drawing caches don't key on those colours, so a cached thumbnail can keep the old colour after a theme change. The fix is to include the theme colours in both caches' keys (or clear the caches when the theme changes), with a test that changes a token and checks that the drawing follows.

Push the fix when you can and we'll re-review. If you're busy, tell us and we can push it (maintainer edits are allowed).

The review finding on e26e5a467 is fixed. The new head is 25b220b34.

1. **[P3] The theme colours in both drawing caches.** Each cache key now holds the inks that its shapes carry.
   - `thumbs.rs`: `thumb_flute` and `tool_shank`.
   - `holder_view.rs`: `tool_axis`, `tool_body`, `tool_edge` and `tool_dim`. The ground and the labels are painted live, so they are not in the key.
   - `build` takes the inks from the key, so the key and the shapes cannot disagree.
   - Pinned by `a_theme_change_of_the_inks_builds_the_row_drawing_again` and `a_theme_change_of_the_inks_builds_the_holder_outline_again` (unit tests in the `camcraft-ui` lib, no new binary). Each test changes the inks and checks one new build with the new colours, then a still drawing. Without the inks in the comparison, both tests are red.
   - The still-frame tests `a_document_row_has_a_cached_drawing_and_its_gauge_length` and `a_still_frame_builds_no_holder_outline` stay green.
2. **Conflict with `main`.** The four PRs under this one are merged. 5b9256022 merges `main` at 498382c8e (no rebase, no force-push). There was no conflict.

Gates on 25b220b34: quick gate 10 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; clippy `--no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings` clean; no heavy lane is reached.

Ready for a re-check.
